caydan__: Dietrich Caydan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Dietrich Caydan was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Dietrich Caydan was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
dilloncoll2015: In Ashford Vale, Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was a railway porter. In R-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
jozifanderson: Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
First Wave. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal.
thebaileeblanks: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments.
